However, this is not a sales trick to lure people into the shop, but is due to the fact that this is where Lindt & Sprüngli’s production plant is based.
The delectable, beautifully packed items in the shop were actually produced just a few hundred meters away – and that is why the surrounding area smells so wonderful.
Lindor chocolate balls, pralines, chocolate bars – everywhere you look, you see the exquisite products for which Switzerland is so famous.
The diversity of the chocolate creations on offer is a treat not only for children’s eyes.
Here you are guaranteed to find something scrumptious to take home to your loved ones.

Besides a wide range of chocolate, guests can also find a photo point, where they can take their own personal souvenir, as well as a machine that shows the entire process from cultivating the cocoa beans right through to creating the finished product.
From May to September, visitors can also register for a 40-minute Chocolate Experience with a Lindt Maître Chocolatier.
Chocolate is always a good option as a souvenir – and here you can find it in all shapes and sizes.
Largest Lindt store worldwide
Chocolate over an area of 500 square meters
At the Lindt Home of Chocolate

label: Lindt Chocolate Shop, Kilchberg
sentences: Überall Schokolade, so weit das Auge reicht – in diesem Geschäft in nahe der Stadt Zürich läuft einem das Wasser im Munde zusammen.
Schokolade liegt in der Luft.
Aber das ist kein Verkaufstrick, um die Leute in den Shop zu ködern, sondern hängt damit zusammen, dass hier auch die Produktionsstätte von Lindt & Sprüngli liegt.
Das, was im Shop so hübsch verpackt auf Schokoladenfans wartet, wurde ganz in der Nähe produziert – darum riecht es in der Umgebung manchmal wundervoll.
Lindorkugeln, Pralinés, Tafelschokolade – überall türmen sich die exquisiten Produkte, für welche die Schweiz so bekannt ist.
Die Vielfalt lässt nicht nur Kinderaugen staunen.
Hier findet sich garantiert ein Mitbringsel für die Liebsten daheim.

Neben dem vielfältigen Schokolade-Sortiment finden Gäste auch einen Fotopunkt für Ihr ganz persönliches Erinnerungsfoto sowie eine mechanische Maschine, die den Prozess vom Kakaoanbau bis zum fertigen Produkt zeigt.
Von Mai bis September können die Besucher sich zudem unter www.lindt.ch zu einem ca. 40-minütigen Schokoladen-Erlebnis mit einem Maître Chocolatier anmelden.
Wer Souvenirs heimbringen will, fährt mit Schokolade nie schlecht – hier gibt es haufenweise davon.
Grösster Lindt Shop weltweit
Schokolade auf 500 Quadratmetern
Beim Lindt Home of Chocolate

label: Lindt Chocolate Shop, Kilchberg
sentences: Partout du chocolat à perte de vue – dans cette boutique proche de la ville de Zurich, l’eau vous vient facilement à la bouche.
Il y a du chocolat dans l’air.
Il ne s’agit toutefois pas d’une vente forcée pour attirer les gens dans la boutique, ici se trouve tout simplement l’atelier de fabrication de Lindt & Sprüngli.
Les amateurs de ces chocolats superbement emballés en boutique découvriront qu’ils ont été fabriqués tout près – ce qui explique la merveilleuse odeur environnante.
Bouchées Lindor, pralinés et tablettes de chocolat – partout s’amoncellent les produits exquis qui font la réputation de la Suisse.
Les enfants ne sont pas les seuls à s’étonner de cette diversité.
Vous trouverez certainement ici le cadeau-souvenir qui ravira vos proches restés chez eux.

En plus d’une gamme très variée de chocolats, les clients trouveront également un point photo pour la photo souvenir ainsi qu’une machine mécanique montrant le processus de la culture du cacao jusqu’au produit fini.
De mai à septembre, les visiteurs peuvent d’ailleurs s’inscrire sur www.lindt.ch pour une expérience chocolat d’env. 40 minutes avec un maître chocolatier.
Le chocolat est toujours une bonne idée de cadeau-souvenir : ici, vous serez comblés.
La plus grande boutique Lindt au monde
Du chocolat sur 500 mètres carrés
Au Lindt Home of Chocolate

label: Lindt Chocolate Shop, Kilchberg
sentences: Cioccolato ovunque, a perdita d’occhio!
Questo negozio vicino a Zurigo fa venire l’acquolina in bocca.
Nell’aria aleggia il profumo del cioccolato.
Ma non è un trucco per aumentare le vendite o per attirare la gente nel negozio, bensì la normale conseguenza del fatto che qui abbia sede anche lo stabilimento produttivo di Lindt & Sprüngli.
Le graziose confezioni che aspettano di essere acquistate dagli amanti del cioccolato vengono prodotte nelle immediate vicinanze.
Per questo la zona è pervasa da un profumo meraviglioso.
Cioccolatini Lindor, praline, tavolette... ovunque si vedono i deliziosi prodotti che rendono la Svizzera così famosa.
E l’enorme varietà non cattura solo i più piccoli.
Qui si trova senz’altro anche un souvenir per i propri cari.

Oltre al ricco assortimento di cioccolato, qui si trovano anche uno spot fotografico per scattare una personalissima foto ricordo e un macchinario che illustra i passaggi dalla coltivazione del cacao al prodotto finito.
Da maggio a settembre, su www.lindt.ch i visitatori possono iscriversi a un’esperienza cioccolatosa di ca. 40 minuti con un maître chocolatier.
Chi cerca un souvenir non può sbagliarsi scegliendo del cioccolato.
Qui ce n’è in abbondanza.
Il più grande Lindt Shop del mondo
Cioccolato su 500 metri quadrati
Al Lindt Home of Chocolate

label: Widder Garden
sentences: Located in the very heart of downtown Zurich, in summer this chic garden paradise delights with appetizing culinary dishes and beverages.
There are some places that you have to know about, otherwise you would never know they were there.
In summer, a veritable oasis is awaiting guests just a stone’s throw from the Bahnhofstrasse shopping street.
In the courtyard of the Widder Hotel, you can take a relaxing break and enjoy a coffee or cool beverage – or linger over a delicious lunch or evening meal.
The summer dishes – whether salads, pasta, fish or specialties from the grill – are perfectly suited to the Mediterranean ambiance of this open-air locale.
And once you have sat down in the lounge, you will be reluctant to get up again – for here you are far removed from the hustle and bustle of the outside world.
An abundance of greenery, crispy salads, pasta and a cool drink – vacation mood in the city center.

label: Widder Garden
sentences: Mitten in der Zürcher Innenstadt lockt im Sommer dieses lauschige Gartenparadies – und verzückt mit leckeren Speisen und Getränken.
Gewisse Orte muss man kennen, sonst findet man sie nicht.
Nur ein paar Schritte weg von der Shoppingwelt der Bahnhofstrasse wartet im Sommer eine Oase auf Gäste.
Im Innenhof des Widder Hotels kann man kurz innehalten und einen Kaffee oder einen kühlen Drink geniessen – oder aber ein leckeres Mittag- oder Abendessen einnehmen.
Die sommerlichen Speisen passen perfekt zum mediterranen Flair dieses Lokals unter freiem Himmel – ob Salate, Pasta, Fisch oder Feines vom Grill.
Und wer einmal in der Lounge Platz genommen hat, möchte eigentlich nie wieder aufstehen.
Denn hier ist jeglicher Trubel weit weg.
Viel Grün, knackige Salate, Pasta und ein kühler Drink – Urlaubsgefühle mitten in der Innenstadt.

label: Widder Garden
sentences: En été, ce jardin paradisiaque discret en plein centre-ville de Zurich séduit par ses boissons et ses plats délicieux.
Il faut connaître ces lieux, sinon ils restent introuvables.
A quelques pas seulement de l’univers du shopping de la Bahnhofstrasse, une oasis de rêve accueille les clients en été.
On peut faire une halte dans le patio de l’hôtel Widder et déguster un café ou une boisson fraîche – ou bien opter pour un savoureux déjeuner ou dîner.
Les plats estivaux comme les salades, pâtes, poissons ou délicieuses grillades s’accordent parfaitement avec le caractère méditerranéen de ce restaurant à ciel ouvert.
Une fois installé au salon-bar, loin de toute l’agitation urbaine, vous aurez bien du mal à vous en extirper.
Verdure, salades croquantes, pâtes et boisson fraîche – un air de vacances en plein centre-ville.

label: Widder Garden
sentences: Durante l’estate, questo tranquillo angolo di paradiso in pieno centro a Zurigo è molto frequentato e convince con piatti e bevande deliziosi.
Alcuni posti bisogna conoscerli, altrimenti non si trovano.
A pochi passi dai negozi della Bahnhofstrasse, in estate ti aspetta una vera e propria oasi.
Nel cortile interno del Widder Hotel, puoi fare una breve pausa, sorseggiando un caffè o un drink fresco oppure gustando un pranzo o una cena.
Che si tratti di insalate, pasta, pesce o grigliate, i piatti estivi sono in perfetta sintonia con l’atmosfera mediterranea del locale a cielo aperto.
Chi si accomoda una volta al Lounge non vuole più andarsene: qui, infatti, la frenesia sembra lontanissima.
Tanto verde, insalate fresche, pasta e drink rinfrescanti: sensazione di vacanza in pieno centro.

label: Sprüngli Boutique at Paradeplatz
sentences: All the classic Sprüngli products can be purchased at the main branch of the famous Zurich confectionery.
Anyone looking for typical Zurich specialties will at some stage always end up at the Confiserie Sprüngli.
Founded in 1836 by David Sprüngli, the company soon belonged to the pioneers of Swiss chocolate producers.
David’s grandchildren later divided the firm between themselves.
This gave rise on the one hand to the chocolate factory now known as Lindt & Sprüngli, and on the other, to the confectionery business, which has stood in a prime location at Paradeplatz since 1859.
The latter is a popular meeting place, not just among the locals, but also for guests from all over the world.

While visitors relax and enjoy delectable Sprüngli creations on the upper floor, the shop on the ground floor sells the entire range of Sprüngli products: Luxemburgerli macarons, praline chocolates, truffles, and mouthwatering chocolate bars.
The main branch of the world-famous Zurich confectioner’s enjoys a prime location at Paradeplatz.
Main branch steeped in history
Located directly on Paradeplatz
With a café and restaurant on the ground and upper floors

label: Sprüngli Boutique at Paradeplatz
sentences: Im Hauptsitz der berühmten Zürcher Konditorei kaufen Liebhaber alle Sprüngli-Klassiker.

Wer auf der Suche nach typisch Zürcherischen Spezialitäten ist, kommt an der Confiserie Sprüngli nicht vorbei. 1836 von David Sprüngli gegründet, gehörte das Unternehmen bald zu den Pionieren der Schweizer Schokoladeproduzenten.
Davids Enkel teilten das Unternehmen später untereinander auf.
Daraus ging einerseits die Schokoladenfabrik hervor, die heute als Lindt & Sprüngli bekannt ist.
Andererseits die deren Hauptsitz seit 1859 am Paradeplatz an bester Lage steht.
Sie ist ein beliebter Treffpunkt.
Nicht nur bei Zürcherinnen und Zürchern, sondern auch von Gästen aus aller Welt.

Während Besucher sich im ersten Stock entspannen und Sprüngli-Leckereien geniessen, steht im Erdgeschoss das Verkaufslokal mit dem gesamten Sprüngli-Sortiment: Luxemburgerli, Pralinés, Truffes und feinster Tafelschokolade.
Die Hauptfiliale der berühmten Zürcher Konditorei steht am Paradeplatz an bester Lage.
Geschichtsträchtige Hauptfiliale
Direkt am Paradeplatz
Mit Café und Restaurant im Erd- sowie im 1.
Obergeschoss

label: Sprüngli Boutique at Paradeplatz
sentences: Les amateurs achètent tous les grands classiques de Sprüngli à la boutique principale de la fameuse confiserie zurichoise.
Si vous êtes à la recherche de spécialités typiquement zurichoises, la confiserie Sprüngli est la bonne adresse.
Fondée en 1836 par David Sprüngli, l’entreprise devint rapidement l’un des pionniers suisses de la production de chocolat.

Les petits-fils de David se partagèrent plus tard l’entreprise avec d’un côté la fabrique de chocolat connue aujourd’hui sous Lindt & Sprüngli et de l’autre côté la confiserie dont la boutique principale est idéalement située depuis 1859 sur la place Paradeplatz.
C’est un lieu de rencontre apprécié non seulement des Zurichois mais aussi des visiteurs du monde entier.

Les visiteurs se détendent au premier étage en savourant les délices Sprüngli, alors qu’au rez-de-chaussée la boutique propose un assortiment complet de Sprüngli : Luxemburgerli, pralinés, truffes et délicieuses tablettes de chocolat.
La boutique principale de la fameuse confiserie zurichoise est idéalement située sur la Paradeplatz.
Boutique principale au passé riche
Directement sur la place Paradeplatz
Avec café et restaurant au rez-de-chaussée et au 1er étage

label: Sprüngli Boutique at Paradeplatz
sentences: Nella sede principale della famosa pasticceria zurighese è possibile acquistare tutti i classici Sprüngli.
Chi cerca specialità tipicamente zurighesi non può perdersi la Confiserie Sprüngli.
Fondata nel 1836 da David Sprüngli, l’azienda è presto diventata leader tra i produttori di cioccolato svizzeri.

I nipoti di David si sono successivamente spartiti la società, dando vita, da un lato, alla fabbrica di cioccolato che oggi è conosciuta come Lindt & Sprüngli, dall’altro, alla sede principale che si trova sulla Paradeplatz dal 1859.
Quest’ultima è un popolare ritrovo per gli abitanti di Zurigo, ma anche per i turisti di tutto il mondo.

Mentre i visitatori si rilassano al primo piano, mangiando le prelibatezze di Sprüngli, al piano terra si trova il negozio con tutto l’assortimento del marchio: Luxemburgerli, Pralinés, Truffes e tavolette di finissimo cioccolato.
La sede principale della famosa pasticceria zurighese si trova in posizione ideale sulla Paradeplatz.
Sede carica di storia
Sulla Paradeplatz
Con caffè e ristorante al piano terra e al primo piano

label: Restaurant Limmathof
sentences: Creative cuisine in the close vicinity of the Viadukt: the Limmathof is a popular restaurant for locals and tourists alike, both at lunchtime and in the evening.
The very central location in the urban Kreis 5 district, opposite the Markthalle Viadukt, makes the Limmathof a popular place for Zurich locals to meet and enjoy great food.
From morning to night, the restaurant serves down-to-earth international cuisine with a particular focus on creative vegetarian dishes.
The restaurant radiates the relaxed ambiance of a neighborhood meeting place.
It is particularly pleasant to sit outside on a warm evening and watch the world go by in the lively quarter.
One thing that is particularly special about the Limmathof is that it runs an integrative program, which offers people with mental disabilities a supervised workplace.
International seasonal cuisine with many vegetarian creations, in the heart of the Kreis 5 district.
Kreis 5 district
Fresh and seasonal international cuisine
Vegetarian specialties

label: Restaurant Limmathof
sentences: Kreative Küche ganz in der Nähe vom Viadukt: Der «Limmathof» ist mittags wie abends ein beliebtes Lokal bei Einheimischen und Touristen.
Die sehr zentrale Lage im urbanen Kreis 5 vis-à-vis der Markthalle Viadukt macht den «Limmathof» zu einer Begegnungs- und Genussstätte für Zürcher Stadtkinder.
Das Lokal wartet von morgens bis abends mit einer bodenständigen Weltküche auf, die den Schwerpunkt auf kreative, vegetarische Gerichte legt.
Das Lokal strahlt die Gemütlichkeit eines Quartiertreffs aus und besonders schön ist es, an einem lauen Abend im Aussenbereich zu sitzen und das Treiben im lebendigen Quartier zu beobachten.
Aussergewöhnlich am «Limmathof» ist auch sein integratives Programm, wo Menschen mit psychisch bedingten Einschränkungen einen betreuten Arbeitsplatz finden.
Internationale Saisonküche mit vielen vegetarischen Kreationen im Herzen vom Kreis 5.
Kreis 5
Frische, saisonale Weltküche
Vegetarische Spezialitäten

label: Restaurant Limmathof
sentences: La cuisine créative du « Limmathof » à proximité immédiate du Viadukt est très appréciée midi et soir des locaux comme des touristes.
Situé au centre du 5e arrondissement en face du marché couvert du Viadukt, le « Limmathof » est un lieu de rencontre et de plaisir pour les enfants de Zurich.
Le restaurant propose midi et soir une cuisine internationale du terroir qui met l’accent sur les plats créatifs et végétariens.
Le restaurant séduit avec sa chaleureuse ambiance de lieu de rencontre de quartier.
Lorsque les soirées sont douces, il est très agréable de s’installer en extérieur et d’observer l’agitation de ce quartier très animé.
Le « Limmathof » est aussi réputé pour son programme intégratif, dans le cadre duquel des personnes psychiquement limitées bénéficient d’un emploi assisté.
Cuisine internationale et de saison avec de nombreuses créations végétariennes au cœur du 5e arr.
5e arrondissement
Cuisine internationale fraîche et de saison
Spécialités végétariennes

label: Restaurant Limmathof
sentences: Cucina creativa vicinissimo al Viadukt: a pranzo e cena, il Limmathof è un locale molto amato dagli abitanti del posto e dai turisti.
La centralissima posizione nell’urbano Kreis 5, proprio di fronte al Viadukt, fa del Limmathof un luogo di aggregazione e gusto per gli abitanti di Zurigo.
Da mattina a sera, il locale serve manicaretti della cucina internazionale, concentrandosi soprattutto su piatti creativi e vegetariani.
Il ristorante emana l’atmosfera di un ritrovo di quartiere.
Nelle serate più miti, è particolarmente bello sedersi nel dehors e osservare il viavai del vivace quartiere.
Un particolare del Limmathof è anche il suo programma integrativo, grazie al quale persone con limiti di natura psichica trovano un posto di lavoro assistito.
Cucina internazionale stagionale con tante creazioni vegetariane nel cuore del Kreis 5.
Kreis 5
Cucina stagionale fresca
Specialità vegetariane

label: Krone Altstetten
sentences: The kitchen and service staff at the Krone Altstetten, in the Altstetten quarter, are passionate about their work.
The cozy restaurant with a walk-in wine cellar is a real gem in the heart of Zurich’s Altstetten quarter.
Wood-paneled walls, a tiled stove, white tablecloths, and discreet décor: as soon as you enter the Krone Altstetten, you immediately feel at home.
New specialties are offered depending on the season.
One particular favorite and a permanent feature on the menu is the “Züri im Pfännli” (Zürcher Geschnetzeltes).
They can also visit the generously stocked cellar to pick out the perfect wine to go with their food.

However, the Krone Altstetten is also a special place in other respects: as a locale run by the Stiftung Arbeitskette (Work Chain Foundation), it offers mentally impaired people professionally supervised workplaces and helps them to establish themselves in the working world.
A cozy restaurant in Altstetten with a tiled stove and Swiss culinary classics.
Historical restaurant
Terrace
Children’s menu

label: Krone Altstetten
sentences: Im Zürcher Stadtteil Altstetten wird im «Krone Altstetten» mit viel Herzblut gekocht und serviert.
Das heimelige Restaurant mit begehbarem Weinkeller ist ein Schmuckstück im Herzen von Altstetten.
Holzverkleidung an den Wänden, ein Kachelofen im Lokal, weisse Tischtücher und dezente Dekoration: Wer die «Krone Altstetten» betritt, fühlt sich sofort willkommen.
Je nach Saison gibt es neue Spezialitäten, ein beliebter Klassiker und fester Punkt auf der Karte ist aber das «Züri im Pfännli» – Zürcher Geschnetzeltes.
Für die Weinauswahl dürfen die Gäste den grosszügig ausgestatteten Keller besuchen und den passenden Tropfen aussuchen.

Die «Krone Altstetten» ist aber auch in anderen Belangen ein spezieller Ort: Als Betrieb der Stiftung Arbeitskette bietet es Menschen mit einer Leistungsbeeinträchtigung professionell betreute Arbeitsplätze und ermöglicht ihnen den Einstieg in die Arbeitswelt.
Ein Gemütliches Restaurant in Altstetten mit Kachelofen und Schweizer Klassikern.
Historische Gaststube
Terrasse
Kindermenü

label: Krone Altstetten
sentences: Le restaurant Krone Altstetten du quartier zurichois d’Altstetten met beaucoup de passion dans son service et ses plats.
Ce chaleureux restaurant avec sa cave à vins qu’on peut visiter est un joyau au cœur d’Altstetten.
Les murs sont revêtus de bois, le restaurant est équipé d’un poêle en faïence, les nappes sont blanches et le décor discret.
Lorsqu’on entre dans le Krone Altstetten on se sent tout de suite bienvenu.
Les spécialités varient selon la saison, un classique incontournable fixe du menu est le « Züri im Pfännli » – l’émincé de veau zurichois.
Les hôtes peuvent se rendre dans la cave à vins généreusement pourvue pour choisir le vin qui accompagnera parfaitement leur plat.
Le Krone Altstetten est un lieu très spécial à bien des égards.
En tant qu’établissement de la fondation Arbeitskette, il propose des emplois assistés par des professionnels à des personnes en situation de handicap, pour qu’ils aient accès au marché du travail.
Chaleureux restaurant d’Altstetten avec poêle en faïence et classiques suisses.
Restaurant historique
Terrasse
Menu enfants

label: Krone Altstetten
sentences: Nel quartiere zurighese di Altstetten, il Krone Altstetten cucina e serve con passione.
L’accogliente ristorante con cantina è un gioiellino nel cuore di Altstetten.
Rivestimenti in legno sulle pareti, stufa in maiolica, tovaglie bianche e decorazioni sobrie: chi entra al Krone Altstetten si sente subito a proprio agio.
Le specialità variano a seconda della stagione, ma un classico molto amato, punto fermo del menu, è lo "Züri im Pfännli", ovvero lo spezzatino alla zurighese.
Il vino si può scegliere di persona dalla fornitissima cantina.

Il Krone Altstetten è un luogo speciale anche per altri aspetti: essendo un’azienda della fondazione Arbeitskette, offre posti di lavoro assistiti a persone con mobilità ridotta, consentendo loro di entrare nel mondo del lavoro.
Un ristorante accogliente ad Altstetten, con stufa in maiolica e classici svizzeri.
Ristorante storico
Terrazza
Menu per bambini

label: Brasserie Federal
sentences: The Brasserie Federal, a locale completely devoted to beer, is situated on Bahnhofquai, in front of Zurich Main Station.
This locale is a pure delight for beer lovers, who can choose from among 50 Swiss beers and a variety of Swiss culinary specialties.
The architecture, furnishings, and traditional music create a feeling of wellbeing and warmth.
For business lunches, the Brasserie Federal offers a new delicious Lunch Special every week.
Here, the focus is on the art of brewing: 50 types of beer and a variety of typical Swiss dishes.
50 Swiss beers
Swiss culinary specialties
Traditional
Cozy
At the Main Station

label: Brasserie Federal
sentences: Am Bahnhofquai, vor dem Zürcher Hauptbahnhof, befindet sich die Brasserie Federal, die sich voll und ganz dem Bier verschrieben hat.
Dieses Lokal lässt das Herz jedes Biergeniessers höherschlagen. Über 50 Schweizer Biere und verschiedene landestypische Spezialitäten können nach Lust und Laune verköstigt werden.
Die Architektur, die Einrichtung und die volkstümliche Musik erzeugen eine wohlige Gemütlichkeit.
Für den Business-Lunch empfiehlt die Brasserie Federal jede Woche ein neues und köstliches Mittagsspecial.
Hier wird die Brauereikunst grossgeschrieben: 50 Biersorten und landestypische Gerichte.
50 Schweizer Biere
Schweizer Spezialitäten
Traditionell
Gemütlich
Hauptbahnhof

label: Brasserie Federal
sentences: Sur le quai devant la gare centrale de Zurich se trouve la « Brasserie Federal » entièrement consacrée à la bière.
Cet établissement fait le bonheur des amateurs de bière.
Il propose plus de 50 bières suisses et diverses spécialités typiques, à déguster selon l’envie et l’humeur.
Grâce à son architecture, à son aménagement et à la musique traditionnelle, cet établissement est un endroit où il fait bon vivre!
La « Brasserie Federal » propose chaque semaine un nouveau et délicieux menu pour les déjeuners d’affaires.
Ici la brasserie est à l’honneur : 50 sortes de bières et des plats typiquement suisses.
50 bières suisses
Spécialités suisses
Traditionnelle
Confortable
Gare centrale

label: Brasserie Federal
sentences: Sul Bahnhofquai, davanti alla Stazione Centrale di Zurigo, si trova la Brasserie Federal, votata interamente alla birra.
Questo locale è una tappa obbligatoria per gli amanti della birra.
Qui è possibile assaggiare oltre 50 birre elvetiche e diverse specialità nazionali.
Architettura, arredamento e musica popolare creano l’atmosfera giusta.
Per un pranzo d’affari, la Brasserie Federal propone ogni settimana un nuovo, delizioso menu speciale.
L’arte birraria è la protagonista indiscussa di questo locale: 50 varietà di birra e piatti tipici.
50 birre svizzere
Specialità svizzere
Tradizionale
Accogliente
Stazione Centrale

label: Sibler
sentences: Anyone looking for high-quality household articles in Zurich should pay a visit to Sibler at Münsterhof.
Every child in Zurich knows the store on the corner of Storchengasse/Münsterhof.
This is hardly surprising, because Sibler has been supplying the people of Zurich with everything a household needs since 1830.
Products range from tableware and kitchen utensils to decorative items and practical furnishings to a wide selection of gift ideas.
With each product, the focus is always on quality and innovation.
In the main store at Münsterhof, customers are invited to browse through the countless quality products spread over two floors and receive competent advice.
Meanwhile, seasonal highlights delight shoppers in the somewhat smaller branch at Viaduktbogen 24 in Zürich-West.
In summer, for example, the right barbecue accessories, or in winter, candle holders and decorative materials – invariably of high-quality and unique.
Everything a household needs can be found at Sibler at Münsterhof.
Household goods
Home furnishings
Gifts

label: Sibler
sentences: Wer in Zürich auf der Suche nach hochwertigen Haushaltsartikeln ist, besucht «Sibler» am Münsterhof.
Jedes Kind kennt in Zürich den Laden an der Ecke Storchengasse/Münsterhof.
Das ist kein Wunder, denn seit 1830 versorgt «Sibler» die Zürcher:innen mit allem, was ein Haushalt so braucht.

sentences: The Studio accommodates a radio studio that broadcasts live every day, together with a café.

The Studio in Zurich’s Seefeld quarter has a unique concept: a bright and friendly café with a view through huge panes of glass of the studio of the Zurich radio station, NRJ.
As a result, while guests are enjoying their morning coffee and a tasty breakfast, they can watch the radio presenters at work.
At lunchtime, The Studio serves up light, healthy dishes, while in the evenings, after-work drinks are accompanied by delicious tapas.

Whether comfortably as a pair or in a group of four snuggling closely together, guests can tuck into this traditional dish in a red gondola.
The gondola cabins once operated on the aerial cableway in Saas-Fee in Canton Valais, not far from Zermatt and the Matterhorn.
With their red & white checkered tablecloths, a petrol lamp, and soft seat covers, the gondolas convey a romantic Alpine mood – right in the heart of Zurich.

Zu zweit, oder eng aneinander gekuschelt auch zu viert, geniessen Gäste die Käse-Spezialität in fünf schmucken roten Seilbahn-Gondeln.
Diese waren einst im Dienst einer Bergbahn in der Walliser Gemeinde Saas-Fee, unweit von Zermatt und dem Matterhorn.
Die Gondeln mit ihren rot-weiss karierten Deckchen, einer Petroleumlampe und weichen Sitzdecken vermitteln richtige Berg-Romantik – mitten in Zürich.

Davanti al ristorante Walliser Keller, famoso per le sue deliziose fondute, gli amanti del formaggio possono gustare questo classico svizzero con un tocco di originalità.

Un tempo venivano usate da un impianto del comune vallesano di Saas-Fee, poco lontano da Zermatt e dal Cervino.

label: Brisket Southern BBQ & Bar
sentences: In the west of Zurich, meat is served Texan-style, cooked in a smoker.
In the Zürich-West quarter, two Swiss brothers are living the American dream – at least in terms of food.

At their cozy, urban restaurant, the Brisket Southern BBQ & Bar, everything revolves around meat – or to be more precise, the cut of beef from the breast or lower chest of the cow known as the brisket.
This is braised for hours in a smoker until the meat is so tender that it falls off the bone.
In addition, the menu features the much -loved pulled pork, the nowadays somewhat neglected pork belly, and the universally popular classic, chicken wings.
Vegetarians are also well catered for with tasty vegetables from the smoker.
American meat specialities prepared in the smoker in relaxed surroundings.

sentences: In Zürichs Westen wird Fleisch auf texanische Art im Smoker zubereitet.
In Zürich-West leben zwei Brüder den amerikanischen Traum – zumindest, was das Essen angeht.
In ihrem urbanen und gemütlichen Restaurant Brisket Southern BBQ & Bar dreht sich alles ums Fleisch, genauer gesagt um das Brust-Stück vom Rind, eben dem Brisket.
Dieses wird über Stunden im Smoker geschmort, bis das Fleisch zart vom Knochen fällt.
Ausserdem gibt es hier das beliebte Pulled Pork und den etwas in Vergessenheit geratenen Schweinebauch (Pork Belly) sowie den allseits beliebten Klassiker Chicken Wings.
Aber auch für Vegetarier ist gesorgt mit leckerem Gemüse aus dem Smoker.

Deux frères vivent leur rêve américain à Zürich-West – au moins concernant l’alimentation.
Dans leur sympathique restaurant urbain Brisket Southern BBQ & Bar, tout tourne autour de la viande ou plutôt de la poitrine de bœuf – le brisket.
On la laisse plusieurs heures au fumoir jusqu’à ce qu’elle devienne tendre et se détache facilement de l’os.
On y propose d’ailleurs aussi le très apprécié porc braisé et la poitrine de porc (pork belly) tombée dans l’oubli ainsi que ces classiques de tous temps très appréciés que sont les ailes de poulet.
Les végétariens en auront aussi pour leur argent avec de délicieux légumes fumés.

sentences: The craft of baking is celebrated here.
A small, cute store on the time-honored Rennweg - direct from the cobblestones into the bread paradise.
Here, no two breads look alike.
And that is a good thing – for it was not a machine that shaped the dough, but baker’s hands.
That manifests itself not only in the products’ appearance, but also their taste.
Whether made with sourdough, spelt or rye, whether a plaited loaf, sweet bakery products or fruit tarts: here everything is fresh and delicious.
Moreover, the staff are pleased to help with information or tips about which tasty treats should be tried in addition to your favorite bread.
Tradition is not always fusty.
The family firm, with over 100 years’ experience, is proof of this.

sentences: Hier wird das Backhandwerk zelebriert.
Ein hübscher, kleiner Laden am altehrwürdigen Rennweg - direkt von den Pflastersteinen ins Brotparadies.
Nicht ein Brot sieht hier gleich aus wie das andere.
Und das ist wundervoll.
Denn es war keine Maschine, die den Teig in Form gebracht hat, sondern Bäckershände.
Das sieht man nicht nur, sondern schmeckt es auch.
Ob mit Sauerteig, Urdinkel oder Roggen, ob Zopf, Süssgebäck oder Wähen: Hier ist alles frisch und lecker.
Ausserdem gibt das Personal gerne Auskunft oder hilft gerne mit Tipps, welche Leckereien man nebst seinem Lieblingsbrot auch einmal ausprobieren sollte.
Tradition muss nicht verstaubt sein.

sentences: On y célèbre la boulangerie artisanale.

Ici, aucun pain ne ressemble à un autre.
Et c’est merveilleux.
Car ce sont les mains du boulanger qui ont donné forme à la pâte et non pas une machine.
On peut l’observer mais aussi le sentir.
Que ce soit avec du levain, de l’épeautre pur ou du seigle, que ce soit des tresses au beurre, des viennoiseries ou des tartes : ici tout est frais et savoureux.
Le personnel se fera un plaisir de vous renseigner et vous recommandera des délices à déguster en plus de votre pain favori.
La tradition ne se démode jamais.
Cette entreprise familiale de plus de 100 ans d’expérience le prouve.

sentences: Qui si celebra l’arte dei fornai.

Qui il pane si presenta in tante varietà diverse.
Ed è una cosa meravigliosa.
Sì, perché l’impasto non viene mescolato da macchinari, bensì dalle mani dei panettieri.
Un dettaglio che si vede e si sente a ogni boccone.
Che si tratti di pasta madre, spelta o segale, di trecce, dolci o crostate, ogni cosa è fresca e deliziosa.
Senza contare che il personale è sempre lieto di fornire informazioni o consigli sulle specialità da provare oltre al proprio pane abituale.
La tradizione è antiquata?

label: Confiserie Honold
sentences: The Confiserie Honold has been producing exquisite pralines and pastries on Zurich’s Rennweg since 1905.
It would be impossible to imagine Zurich without the tradition-steeped confectioner’s store with the Café Honold on Rennweg.
Since it was founded in 1905, the flagship store has been housed in a central location on Rennweg, just off the Bahnhofstrasse.
The business is currently run by the fourth generation.

Among the absolute classics of the Confiserie Honold is everything that fits into the pastries and confectionery category: besides Pain de Gênes – a special almond sponge cake made according to a family recipe – this also comprises confections, chocolate, and pralines.
In addition, the assortment includes bread and ice cream.
When visiting the café on Rennweg , you should be sure to also try the Bircher muesli.​
The tradition-steeped confectionery on Zurich’s Rennweg is an absolute Zurich classic.

label: Confiserie Honold
sentences: Seit 1905 produziert die Confiserie Honold feine Pralinés und Gebäck am Zürcher Rennweg.
Die traditionsreiche Confiserie mit Café Honold am Rennweg ist aus Zürich nicht wegzudenken.
Bereits seit der Gründung im Jahr 1905 ist das Stammhaus sehr zentral am Rennweg nahe der Bahnhofstrasse beheimatet.
Inzwischen wird die Confiserie in der vierten Generation geführt.

Zu den Klassikern der Confiserie Honold gehört alles, was in die Kategorie Gebäck und Süsswaren passt: Neben dem Pain de Gênes – einem besonderen Mandelbiskuit nach Familienrezept –, sinde das Konfekt, Schokolade und Pralinen.
Zum Sortiment gehören aber auch Brotwaren und Speiseeis.
Bei einem Besuch am Rennweg sollte unbedingt auch das Birchermüesli des Hauses gekostet werden.
Das Traditionshaus am Zürcher Rennweg ist ein Klassiker in Zürich.

La confiserie traditionnelle & café Honold du Rennweg de Zurich est incontournable.
Depuis sa céation en 1905, le magasin principal est au cœur du Rennweg près de la rue Bahnhofstrasse.
La confiserie est aujourd’hui gérée par la quatrième génération.

La Confiserie Honold propose toutes les pâtisseries et confiseries devenues de grands classiques comme le Pain de Gênes – biscuit aux amandes d’après une recette familiale – les pralinés, confiseries et chocolats.
On y vend aussi des pains et des glaces.
Si vous visitez le Rennweg , goûtez absolument les mueslis Bircher maison.

His contact with eminent representatives from the worlds of politics, culture and society also helped raise public awareness for the city of Zurich.

Anyone interested in finding out more about Lavater’s life and works should pay a visit to the Lavater House, where pictures, books, autographs and various other objects from the 18th century are kept.

label: Cassiopeia Boardwalk
sentences: The Cassiopeia boardwalk enables pedestrians and joggers to follow a route all the way along the left bank of Lake Zurich without interruption.
The 2.8m (92ft) wide and 284m (932ft) long Cassiopeia boardwalk closes the gap in the lakeside path between the center for alternative culture, the Rote Fabrik, and Wollishofen Harbor.
Pedestrians and joggers can now follow a route without interruption along the picturesque lakeshore from Bürkliplatz in central Zurich as far as the municipal boundary in Wollishofen.
The attractive construction extends 100m (330ft) into the lake, making the Alpine panorama seem even closer than from the Quaibrücke bridge at Bürkliplatz.
In addition, the narrow walkway between land and water gives you the feeling that you are actually standing in the middle of the lake.
Incidentally, the boardwalk is lit up at night, offering a particular good view of the starry sky in fine weather.
Then budding astronomers both big and small can see, among other things, the constellation Cassiopeia, which has lent the boardwalk its name.
The 284m (932ft) long boardwalk on Lake Zurich links the Rote Fabrik with Wollishofen Harbor.

label: Cassiopeia Boardwalk
sentences: Dank dem Cassiopeiasteg können Spaziergänger:innen und Läufer:innen fast das ganze städtische linke Seeufer ohne Unterbruch abschreiten.
Der 2.8 Meter breite und 284 Meter lange Cassiopeiasteg schliesst die Lücke im Uferweg zwischen dem alternativen Kulturzentrum Rote Fabrik und dem Hafen Wollishofen.
Dadurch ist es Fussgänger:innen und Läufer:innen möglich, vom Bürkliplatz aus durchgehend auf einem hübschen Uferweg entlang des Zürichsees bis an die Stadtgrenze in Wollishofen zu laufen.
Die hübsche und leichtfüssige Konstruktion führt 100 Meter in den See hinaus, von wo aus man sich dem Alpenpanorama noch näher fühlt als bereits von der Quaibrücke beim Bürkliplatz aus.
Zudem vermittelt das Band zwischen Land und Wasser den Spaziergänger:innen das Gefühl, mitten im See zu stehen.
In der Nacht ist der Steg übrigens nicht beleuchtet, warum sich bei klarem Wetter ein besonders hübscher Blick in den Sternenhimmel bietet.
Dann sehen kleine und grosse Astronomen unter anderem das Sternbild Cassiopeia, welches dem Holzsteg seinen Namen gegeben hat.
Der 284 Meter lange Steg im Zürichsee verbindet die Rote Fabrik mit dem Hafen Wollishofen.

sentences: La passerelle Cassiopeiasteg permet aux promeneurs et aux coureurs de longer presque toute la zone urbaine zurichoise sur la rive gauche du lac.
La passerelle Cassiopeiasteg, 2,8 mètres de large et 284 mètres de long, prolonge le chemin de rive du centre culturel alternatif Rote Fabrik jusqu’au port de Wollishofen.
Elle permet aux piétons et aux coureurs de parcourir la jolie promenade au bord du lac de Zurich sans interruption, de la Bürkliplatz jusqu’à la frontière de la ville à Wollishofen.
La belle construction gracieuse emmène les passants à 100 mètres du bord du lac.
Ainsi, le panorama alpin semble encore plus près que lorsqu’on se trouve sur le pont Quaibrücke près de la Bürkliplatz et on a l’impression de se promener au milieu du lac.
La nuit, la passerelle n’est pas éclairée et offre, par temps clair, des belles vues dégagées sur le ciel étoilé.
Petits et grands astronomes ont alors la possibilité d’observer la constellation Cassiopeia qui a donné son nom à la passerelle en bois.
La passerelle de 284 m, construite sur le lac de Zurich, relie la Rote Fabrik au port de Wollishofen.

label: Cassiopeia Boardwalk
sentences: Grazie a questa passerella (Cassiopeiasteg), è possibile percorrere senza interruzioni quasi tutta la sponda lacustre sinistra della città.

Piccoli e grandi astronomi possono così ammirare, tra le altre cose, la costellazione di Cassiopea, che dà il nome alla passerella.

label: Bürkliterrasse – Zurich's Front Row Seat by the Lake
sentences: From the Bürkliterrasse in Zurich you enjoy views over Lake Zurich as far as the Alps.
The Bürkliterrasse – opened in 1887 as crowning finale of the Bahnhofstrasse and part of the lakeside park area (Quaianlage) – is the ideal spot to sit and relax under the trees.

sentences: Famous names such as James Joyce, Einstein, Lenin, and the Dadaists once frequented this locale – the history-steeped café is now an integral part of the cityscape.

The art nouveau Grand Café Odeon opened its doors to the people of Zurich for the first time on 1 July 1911 and has delighted guests from near and far ever since.

The Karlsturm is one of the two towers of Zurich’s landmark, the Grossmünster Church.

The Grossmünster Church is a former monastery built on the graves of the city’s patron saints, Felix and Regula, and is the site of the first secondary school, which according to legend, was founded by Charlemagne.
His statue stands on top of the south tower, the Karlsturm.

label: Uetliberg – Zurich’s Very Own Mountain
sentences: The Uetliberg is Zurich’s very own "mountain".
From the top, visitors can enjoy beautiful views of the city and lake – and perhaps even a glimpse of the Alps.
At 871 meters (2,858 feet) above sea level, the Uetliberg towers over the rooftops of Zurich.
From the top, visitors are treated to a magnificent panoramic view of the city, the lake, and the Alps.
The Uetliberg is particularly popular in November, as its summit is often above the blanket of fog that frequently envelops the city at this time of year.
In winter, the hiking trails are transformed into toboggan runs, while in summer, the mountain is a popular departure point for well-marked hikes and mountain bike tours.
More tips all about the Uetliberg can be found here .
Paths on the Uetliberg Hohenstein Trail: This path leads from the Triemli bus stop via the playground at Hohensteinplatz.
Here, the Hohenstein Teehüsli (in fine weather, open on Sundays from 10am to 4pm) invites walkers to take a relaxing break.
From here, it is about 25 minutes to the summit.
Sequoia Avenue: From the Hohensteinplatz playground, a picturesque path leads through the impressive avenue of sequoia trees to the Ringlikon bus stop – perfect for a leisurely walk.
Lantern Path (Alter Uetlibergweg): A steep but rewarding trail starting at Albisgüetli and leading all the way to the top of Uetliberg.
Planet Trail: This themed hike starts at the Felsenegg cableway in Adliswil and in around two hours takes visitors on a journey through the solar system, with information panels along the way.
Temporary Closure: Due to construction work, the SZU underground station (tracks 21/22) at Zurich Main Station will be completely closed from April 29 to December, 2026.
The S10 train line will only run as far as Selnau.
SBB and ZVV recommend that travelers switch to trams and buses.
The Felsenegg cable car will be out of service on March 2027 due to maintenance work.

Planetenweg (sentiero dei pianeti): un sentiero tematico che inizia alla funivia Felsenegg ad Adliswil e percorre l’intero sistema solare in circa due ore, con tanto di tappe informative.

label: Alfred Escher Statue
sentences: The Swiss politician and entrepreneur Alfred Escher watches over Zurich's Bahnhofstrasse.
Swiss sculptor Richard Kissling created this bronze statue in 1889 in honor of Alfred Escher, a renowned Zurich politician and entrepreneur.
Escher founded one of Switzerland’s two large banks and three of its largest insurance companies to finance and insure the Gotthard railway line and tunnel, among other things.
Because there were not enough engineers available for the construction, he also co-founded the Swiss Federal Institute of Technology.

The sculpture is located at the heart of Escher’s achievements: between the Swiss Federal Institute of Technology, the Main Railway Station (as a link to the Gotthard railway line) and the Paradeplatz , a banking site.

Escher gründete eine der beiden Schweizer Grossbanken und drei der grössten Versicherungen – unter anderem, um die Gotthardbahn und den Gotthardtunnel zu finanzieren.
Weil es für den Bau nicht genug Ingenieure gab, begründete er die Eidgenössische Technische Hochschule mit, wodurch die Ausbildung der Ingenieure gesichert war.
Die Plastik steht inmitten Eschers Errungenschaften: Zwischen Eidgenössischer Technischer Hochschule, dem Hauptbahnhof – als Bindeglied zur Gotthardbahn – und dem Paradeplatz , dem Bankenstandort.

sentences: L’entrepreneur et homme politique suisse Alfred Escher veille sur la Bahnhofstrasse de Zurich.
En 1889, le sculpteur suisse Richard Kissling réalisa une sculpture en bronze à l’effigie d’Alfred Escher, politicien et entrepreneur visionnaire zurichois.

Alfred Escher a fondé l’une des deux plus grandes banques suisses et trois des plus importantes compagnies d’assurance afin de pouvoir, entre autres, financer et garantir la ligne de chemin de fer et le tunnel du Gothard.
Comme il n’y avait pas assez d’ingénieurs pour réaliser la construction, Escher a participé à la fondation de l’Ecole Polytechnique Fédérale de Zurich pour assurer leur formation.

La sculpture d’Alfred Escher se trouve au milieu de ses réalisations : entre l’Ecole Polytechnique Fédérale, la gare centrale – liaison à la ligne ferroviaire du Gothard – et Paradeplatz , place où siègent de nombreuses banques.

label: Alfred Escher Statue
sentences: Il politico e imprenditore svizzero Alfred Escher sorveglia la Bahnhofstrasse di Zurigo.

Il monumento (una statua di bronzo che si erge su una fontana in granito rossastro) fu realizzato in onore del politico e imprenditore zurighese Alfred Escher dallo scultore svizzero Richard Kissling e inaugurato nel 1889 sulla piazza della stazione di Zurigo.

Il visionario Alfred Escher fondò una delle due grandi banche svizzere e tre delle compagnie assicurative più grandi, tra le altre cose per poter finanziare e garantire il completamento della ferrovia e della galleria del Gottardo.
Spinto dal fatto che per la costruzione non ci fossero abbastanza ingegneri, Escher partecipò alla fondazione del Politecnico Federale di Zurigo.
La scultura si trova in mezzo alle conquiste di Escher: tra Politecnico Federale, Stazione Centrale (come anello di congiunzione con la ferrovia del Gottardo) e Paradeplatz , sede delle banche.

sentences: Switzerland's largest art museum inspires with its light-flooded extension by David Chipperfield, as well as with one of the most important collections of art in the country.

At the Kunsthaus Zürich, art enthusiasts and novices alike can immerse themselves in the world of the Old Masters, discover Swiss artists such as Giacometti and Fischli/Weiss, or admire Impressionist or contemporary art.

label: Limmat River Cruise
sentences: A boat trip on the River Limmat will take you on a leisurely tour past the most beautiful sights that Zurich’s Old Town has to offer until the view opens up over Lake Zurich.

Past the historical guild houses, Zurich’s Town Hall, the Lindenhof and the Grossmünster church: a Limmat River Cruise takes you from the National Museum up the River Limmat to Lake Zurich and back again.
Since April 2023, the electric boats, “Fluvius”, “Navalis”, and “Pontus”, have been operating on this route.

The e-Limmat boats not only feature electric propulsion for the first time, but also offer a higher passenger capacity, are air-conditioned, and are partially wheelchair accessible (up to a maximum of 80 cm; boarding and disembarking only possible at the National Museum station).
The glass roof allows passengers in all seats to enjoy the view of the picturesque old town and Lake Zurich.
The Limmat River Cruises operate between April and October.
The stretch between the National Museum and the Zürichhorn takes approximately 25 minutes, while the entire round trip lasts around 50 minutes.

sentences: The Ganymed sculpture has adorned the Bürkliterrasse since 1952.
In mythology, the beautiful young boy of Zeus is abducted and taken to Mount Olympus.
According to Greek mythology, Ganymede, the handsome king's son, was abducted by Zeus and taken up to the top of Mount Olympus.
The statue completed by Hermann Hubacher in 1952 does not, however, depict this abduction instead symbolizes man's longing to ascend Mount Olympus.
With an outstretched hand, Ganymede pleads with Zeus, the father of the gods (who appears as an eagle), to take him there.
The work of art is inspired by ancient mythology but artist Hubacher emphasized that his sculpture was “not a Greek Ganymed but rather a Swiss one”.

label: National Museum Zurich
sentences: The National Museum Zurich is located behind the Main Station and is the most frequently visited museum of cultural history in Switzerland.
The National Museum, which stands next to Zurich Main Station, is reminiscent of a fairytale castle.

However, anyone passing through the arches into the inner courtyard will also find a modern new building, which counterbalances the original one designed by architect Gustav Gull in the historicism style.
The exhibits in the rooms and halls of the National Museum tell much about the history of Switzerland – from its very beginnings to the present day, from warring Confederates to voting women.
In addition, socially relevant topics are examined in various special exhibitions.
Audio guides are available in various languages, either on a rental device or via the “National Museum” smartphone app.
The permanent exhibition, “Simply Zurich”, on the upper floor of the historical part of the museum is free of charge.
It shows the diversity of the City and Canton of Zurich in a playful and subjective way.
At the heart of the exhibition is a display case containing 60 objects, all of which tell a story about Zurich’s rich past.
The exhibition is suitable for international guests and locals alike.
The picturesque inner courtyard of the National Museum is often also used concerts and other events.
This gives rise to a particularly interesting contrast between history, current times, old, and young.
The excellent museum store sells high-quality souvenirs and products made and designed by Swiss artisans.
Both inside and out, the National Museum behind the Main Station is an impressive architectural gem.

sentences: The much-loved and legendary Aelpli Bar is tucked away in a backstreet in the heart of the Niederdorf, an area of Zurich’s Old Town.
A piece of tradition has been preserved in the heart of Zurich’s Old Town: the Aelpli Bar possesses one of the oldest tavern licenses in the city.

Incidentally, people who pay a visit to the Aelpli Bar drink Aelpli Milk.
This milk, which is fortified with alcohol, is – so to speak – the “shot” of the house, and should be consumed with caution – for it quickly goes to your head.
The wooden tables, chairs and pillars are adorned with notches, marks and carvings, for anyone who would like to immortalize themselves in the timber is welcome to do so.

label: Augustinerkirche – From House of God to Coin Workshop
sentences: The Augustinerkirche church in Zurich was a coin workshop for 300 years.
Today the Münzplatz square reflects the church's temporary use.
This church of the Hermits of St.
Augustine was built in 1270 on Zurich’s western city walls.
During the Reformation, the church was transformed into a coin workshop.
Zurich’s Catholic church reclaimed the building in 1841.
When the community rejected the dogma of the First Vatican Council, it was excluded from the Catholic church and became known as a Christian Catholic community.
The Augustinerkirche remained the local place of worship.
Renovation work undertaken in 1959 gave the church its current appearance.
The simple choir area, crucifixion scene, block altar, baptismal font by Franz Fischer and stained glass by August Wanner are well worth a visit.
The Augustinerkirche church in Zurich was a coin workshop for 300 years.

Als die Gemeinde die Dogmen des 1.
Vatikanischen Konzils ablehnte, wurde sie aus der katholischen Kirche ausgeschlossen.
Sie nannte sich fortan christkatholische Gemeinde.

La chiesa degli eremiti agostiniani fu costruita nel 1270 lungo il muro occidentale di Zurigo.
Durante la Riforma, fu adibita a laboratorio di numismatica.
Solo nel 1841 tornò a fungere da chiesa per mano dei cattolici zurighesi.
Quando il comune rifiutò i dogmi del Concilio Vaticano Primo, fu esclusa dalla chiesa cattolica e iniziò a chiamarsi comunità cristiano-cattolica.
La Augustinerkirche continuò ad essere la sua chiesa.
Durante il rinnovo nel 1959, ottenne il suo aspetto odierno.
Da vedere sono il coro semplice, il gruppo della crocifissione, l'altare, la fonte battesimale di Franz Fischer e le vetrate di August Wanner.
La Augustinerkirche di Zurigo è stata un laboratorio di numismatica per 300 anni.

label: Fraumünster – art, history and divine stained glass windows
sentences: The Fraumünster and Grossmünster churches are landmarks of Zurich.
The convent once held great power in Zurich.
Founded in 853 by King Louis the German, this church with its convent was inhabited by the female members of the aristocracy of Europe.
The convent enjoyed the patronage of kings and the abbess the right to mint coins in Zurich until well into the 13th century.
Ownership of the church and convent passed to the city of Zurich after the Reformation.
Important architectural features include the Romanesque chancel and the high vaulted transept.
The nave was last renovated in 1911.

Its most stunning treasures are the stained glass windows: those in the north transept are by Augusto Giacometti and the five-part cycle in the chancel and rosette in the southern transept the works of Marc Chagall .
The cloister also reveals a series of frescos by Paul Bodmer.

label: Liebfrauenkirche – Catholic Church
sentences: Standing slightly higher than Zurich’s Main Train Station, the University Quarter and Central traffic hub, the Liebfrauenkirche church comes into view.
During the 19th century, the number of Catholics in Zurich grew significantly.
The urgent need arose for a second Catholic church in addition to the St.
Peter and Paul church.
The Liebfrauenkirche was built in 1894 in the style of an early Christian basilica, based on plans by the architect August Hardegger.
It was built in honor of Mary, the mother of God.
The tower is reminiscent of a Romanesque campanile, a freestanding clock tower.
The Liebfrauenkirche was based on these Italian models to reflect the ties of the Roman Catholic church in Switzerland with the Pope and Rome.

label: St. Peter – the Oldest Parish Church in Zurich
sentences: The St.
Peter church in Zurich has the largest church clock face in Europe.
Until 1911, the church tower was used as a fire watch post.
St.
Peter’s Church is the oldest parish church in Zurich.
The original foundation walls from the 9th century are still visible under the choir.
The city’s first mayor, Rudolf Brun, acquired St.
Peter's in 1345 with all the associated privileges and obligations.
His grave and monument can be found by the outer tower wall.
The first reformed pastor, Leo Jud (1523-1542), was a friend of Zwingli and contributed to the first translation of the Bible in Zurich.
J.C.
Lavater was pastor from 1778-1801.
His gravestone can be seen in the church wall.
The church clock face measures 8.7meters (25.5 ft) in diameter.
There are five bells dating from 1880 in the tower – the largest of which weighs over six tons without its clapper.
At St.
Peter's, church music concerts are held regularly.

label: Wasserkirche
sentences: Legend has it that the site of the Wasserkirche church is where Zurich’s patron saints, Felix and Regula, were executed.
The "Water Church" was originally built on a small island where, according to legend, the city's martyrs Felix and Regula were executed by the Romans.
This late Gothic church was completed towards the end of the 15th century and was regarded as being particularly holy.
This is why, during the Reformation, it was referred to as a "temple of idol worshippers".
A warehouse and then a municipal library were set up to prevent anyone being tempted to re-introduce the cult of the saints.

The Shedhalle is situated in the grounds of the Rote Fabrik in Zurich, which has served as a cultural center since the early 1980s.
The Shedhalle is a space for contemporary art that casts a critical eye over socio-political developments.
Temporary exhibitions here focus on issues ranging from politics to cultural phenomena and from social roles and exclusion to alternative ways of life.
These issues are explored from a range of perspectives – from the viewpoint of artists, activists, and scientists.
Themed weeks, movie presentations, and talks offer in-depth analysis of a range of key issues and conflicts from all over the world.

sentences: Aktions- und Ausstellungsraum auf dem Gelände der Roten Fabrik, direkt am Zürichsee.
Die Shedhalle befindet sich auf dem Gelände der Roten Fabrik, das seit den frühen Achtzigerjahren als Zürcher Kulturzentrum genutzt wird.
Die Shedhalle ist ein Raum für zeitgenössische Kunst, die ein kritisches Licht auf gesellschaftspolitische Entwicklungen wirft.
Die wechselnden Ausstellungen befassen sich mit Themen von Politik über Kulturphänomene, von gesellschaftlichen Rollen und Ausgrenzung bis zu alternativen Lebensentwürfen.
Die Fragestellungen werden aus unterschiedlichen Perspektiven betrachtet – von Künstlerinnen und Künstlern, Aktivistinnen und Aktivisten sowie Wissenschaftlerinnen und Wissenschaftlern.
Themenwochenenden, Filmvorführungen und Vorträge erlauben eine vertiefte Auseinandersetzung mit vielen brennenden Fragen und Konflikten aus aller Welt.

La Shedhalle è uno spazio per l’arte contemporanea che mette in discussione gli sviluppi sociopolitici.

label: Giacometti Frescos (“Blüemlihalle”)
sentences: Thanks to Augusto Giacometti, what is probably the most beautiful police station entrance hall worldwide is located in the heart of Zurich.

The Work Gustav Gull, until 1900 Zurich’s municipal architect and mastermind behind the National Museum , was entrusted with the task of converting a former orphanage into a municipal building to house the city police headquarters.
In order to save space, the vaulted ceiling of what had been the cellar was transformed into the entrance area.
In 1922, the City of Zurich launched a competition to paint the entrance hall, with the aim of brightening up the gloomy space and creating work opportunities for local artists.
Augusto Giacometti (1877–1947) won the competition with ease.
His design in warm red and ochre tones was executed between 1923 and 1925 using the al fresco and al secco techniques.
The ceiling and vault paintings comprise ornamental floral designs and geometric patterns.
The walls, meanwhile, depict people at work: stone carvers and carpenters represent the handicraft trade, while astronomers and magicians denote science.
Nowadays, the art-in-architecture work, which was extensively restored in 2019, is considered to be of national importance.
Special Remarks The locals affectionately refer to the Giacometti Hall as the “Blüemlihalle” (hall of little flowers) due to its design featuring countless ornamental flowers.
Location The “Blüemlihalle” in the Amtshaus I is probably the world’s most beautiful police station entrance hall by far.
The Creator Augusto Giacometti (1877–1947) created the choir windows in the Grossmünster in 1933, as well as a stained-glass window in the Fraumünster in 1945.
He came from the famous Giacometti dynasty of painters, which also included Giovanni Giacometti and sculptor Alberto Giacometti.
Thanks to Augusto Giacometti, the world’s most beautiful police station entrance hall is in Zurich.
Important art-in-architecture work
Executed between 1923 and1925
In the entrance of the city police headquarters

label: Giacometti Frescos (“Blüemlihalle”)
sentences: Mit dem Fresko von Augusto Giacometti beherbergt die Regionalwache City der Zürcher Stadtpolizei eines der bedeutendsten Kunst-und-Bau-Werke der Stadt.
Das Werk: Gustav Gull, bis 1900 Stadtbaumeister von Zürich und Architekt des Landesmuseums , wurde mit dem Umbau eines ehemaligen Waisenhauses in ein Amtshaus betraut.

Um Platz zu sparen, wurde das ehemalige Kellergewölbe zum Eingangsbereich umfunktioniert. 1922 lancierte die Stadt Zürich einen Wettbewerb zur Ausmalung der Eingangshalle, mit dem Ziel, den düsteren Raum aufzuhellen und der lokalen Künstlerschaft Arbeitsmöglichkeiten zu verschaffen.
Augusto Giacometti (1877 – 1947) gewann den Wettbewerb mit Abstand.
Sein Entwurf in warmen Rot- und Ockertönen wurde von 1923 bis 1925 in der Al-Fresco- und Al-Secco-Technik ausgeführt.

Die Decken- und Gewölbemalereien bestehen aus Blumenornamenten und geometrischen Mustern, an den Wänden sind arbeitende Menschen dargestellt: Steinhauer und Zimmerleute stehen für das Handwerk, Astronomen und Magier vertreten die Wissenschaft.
Das im Jahr 2019 umfassend restaurierte Kunst-und-Bau-Werk hat heute nationale Bedeutung.
Besonderes: Die lokale Bevölkerung nennt die Giacometti-Halle dank ihrer unzähligen Blumen-Ornamente liebevoll die «Blüemlihalle» (Schweizerdeutsch für Blümchen-Halle).
Standort: Die «Blüemlihalle» im Amtshaus I ist wohl mit Abstand die schönste Eingangshalle zu einer Polizeiwache weltweit.
Der Schöpfer: Augusto Giacometti (1877 – 1947) schuf 1933 die Chorfenster im Grossmünster sowie 1945 ein Kirchenfenster im Fraumünster in Zürich.
Er entstammte der berühmten Malerdynastie Giacometti, welcher auch Giovanni Giacometti sowie der Bildhauer Alberto Giacometti angehörten.
Die wohl schönste Eingangshalle einer Polizeiwache steht dank Augusto Giacometti im Herzen von Zürich.
Bedeutendes Kunst-und-Bau-Werk
Entstanden 1923 – 1925

label: Giacometti Frescos (“Blüemlihalle”)
sentences: Le poste régional City de la police municipale de Zurich abrite l’une des plus importantes œuvres artistiques et architecturales de la ville : les fresques d’Augusto Giacometti.
L’œuvre : Gustav Gull, urbaniste municipal de Zurich et architecte du Musée national suisse jusqu’en 1900, fut chargé de transformer un ancien orphelinat en bâtiment administratif.
Pour gagner de la place, l’ancienne cave voûtée fut aménagée en hall d’entrée.
En 1922 la ville de Zurich lança un concours pour faire travailler les artistes locaux dans l’espoir qu’ils apportent plus de lumière dans ce trop sombre hall d’entrée.
Augusto Giacometti (1877 – 1947) gagna ce concours haut la main.
Il réalisa une ébauche aux tons chauds rouge et ocre de 1923 à 1925 selon les techniques a fresco et a secco.

Les peintures du plafond et des voûtes consistent en ornements floraux et dessins géométriques, sur les murs sont représentés des personnages en action : tailleurs de pierre et charpentiers pour l’artisanat, astronomes et magiciens pour les sciences.
Cette œuvre entièrement restaurée en 2019 revêt aujourd’hui une importance nationale.
Particularités : Les habitants de la région appellent affectueusement la salle Giacometti «Blüemlihalle» (salle des petites fleurs) en raison de sa conception avec d'innombrables fleurs ornementales.
Emplacement : Le « Blüemlihalle » du bâtiment administratif Amtshaus I est sans doute l’un des plus beaux halls d’entrée d’un poste de police du monde.
Le créateur : Augusto Giacometti (1877 – 1947) a réalisé les vitraux du chœur de l’église Grossmünster en 1933 ainsi qu’un vitrail de l’église Fraumünster en 1945.
Il est issu de la célèbre dynastie des peintres Giacometti, à laquelle appartiennent également Giovanni Giacometti et le sculpteur Alberto Giacometti.
Grâce à Augusto Giacometti, à Zurich se trouve le plus beau hall d’entrée d’un poste de police.
Importante œuvre artistique
Créée de 1923 à 1925
Entrée du poste régional City de la police municipale de Zurich

label: Giacometti Frescos (“Blüemlihalle”)
sentences: Con l’affresco di Augusto Giacometti, il posto di polizia di Zurigo ospita una delle più significative opere artistiche e architettoniche della città.
L’opera A Gustav Gull, architetto della città di Zurigo fino al 1900 e architetto del Museo Nazionale Svizzero , venne affidata la conversione di un ex orfanotrofio in un edificio amministrativo.
Per risparmiare spazio, quella che un tempo era stata la cantina a volte fu trasformata nell’ingresso.
Nel 1922, la città di Zurigo lanciò un bando di concorso per dipingere l’atrio d’ingresso.
Lo scopo era quello di rendere più luminoso il locale e di dare lavoro agli artisti locali.
Augusto Giacometti (1877 – 1947) vinse il bando con un grande vantaggio sui rivali.
La sua bozza nelle calde tonalità del rosso e dell’ocra venne eseguita tra il 1923 e il 1925 con le tecniche a fresco e a secco.

Nei dipinti del soffitto e delle volte si vedono ornamenti floreali e motivi geometrici, mentre sulle pareti sono state raffigurate persone al lavoro: tagliapietre e carpentieri simboleggiano l’artigianato, astronomi e maghi rappresentano le scienze.
Restaurata nel 2019, l’opera riveste oggi importanza nazionale.
Particolarità Per via degli innumerevoli decori floreali, gli abitanti del posto chiamano affettuosamente la sala Giacometti “Blüemlihalle”, svizzero tedesco per “sala dei fiorellini”.
Luogo La sala Giacometti nell’Amtshaus I è la più bella entrata di una stazione di polizia in tutto il mondo.
L’autore Nel 1933, Augusto Giacometti (1877 – 1947) realizzò le vetrate del coro della Chiesa di Grossmünster e, nel 1945, una vetrata della Chiesa di Fraumünster a Zurigo.
Faceva parte della famosa dinastia di artisti Giacometti, alla quale appartenevano anche Giovanni Giacometti e lo scultore Alberto Giacometti.
L’entrata più bella di una stazione di polizia si trova a Zurigo ed è opera di Augusto Giacometti.

sentences: Hugo Ball and Emmy Hennings founded the Cabaret Voltaire in the middle of Zurich’s Old Town in 1916.
It was here that Dada was born.
The Cabaret Voltaire is the birthplace of the world-famous Dada movement, which started in Zurich in 1916.
In the middle of the First World War, Dada awakened the desire to question the present with new and surprising forms of artistic performance, expressed through music, literature, dance, and painting.
With temporary exhibitions in the Vaulted Cellar and the Soirées in the HistoricalHall, the Cabaret Voltaire serves as a platform for contemporary art and debates.
Guests can find a bar in the Historical Hall and the Artists’ Bar in the entrance area, where exhibitions are held by one artist for one year at a time.
The Dada Library on the second floor contains significant Dada publications and can be used as a workplace during the day.
The Dada movement, a mix of art and the absurd, was founded in the heart of Zurich’s Old Town.

sentences: The ringing and rattling of trams is part of everyday life in Zurich.

Trams have a long-standing tradition in Zurich.

label: Beyer Clock and Watch Museum
sentences: The Beyer Clock and Watch Museum is located on Zurich's Bahnhofstrasse in addition to the department stores and shops.
One of the world’s leading private collections of clocks can be found at the Beyer Clock and Watch Museum.

Around 260 very valuable exhibits present the history of timekeeping from 1400 BC to the present day: from sundials to water and tower clocks, Renaissance automata, magnificent pendulum clocks, elaborately decorated pocket watches and the prototype of the first quartz wristwatch.
Scientific navigation devices are also featured.
Some very fragile automatic watches can also be seen in operation – a real rarity.
Video recordings show these artistic masterpieces in operation.
In addition, visitors can find more information about most of the exhibited watches and clocks in three different languages (DE, EN, FR) using the iPads provided.

sentences: Le musée de l'horlogerie Beyer se trouve près des commerces et magasins de la Bahnhofstrasse à Zurich.

De plus, les visiteurs peuvent consulter sur des iPad, en trois langues (DE, EN, FR), des informations sur la plupart des montres exposées.

Circa 260 preziosissimi esemplari narrano la storia della misurazione del tempo dal 1400 a.C. a oggi: da orologi solari e ad acqua, orologi di campanili, orologi automatici del Rinascimento, sfarzosi pendoli, orologi da tasca con casse artisticamente decorate fino al prototipo del primo orologio da polso al quarzo.

label: “Heureka” by Jean Tinguely
sentences: The first “purposeless machine” by Jean Tinguely stands on the shore of Lake Zurich and still functions perfectly today.
The Work Jean Tinguely created the huge kinetic sculpture entitled “Heureka” out of iron bars, wheels, and metal pans and pipes for the National Exhibition in Lausanne in 1964.
The name “Heureka” (Eureka) – which is Ancient Greek for “I’ve found it” – is meant ironically, for the sculpture is a machine without purpose.

Tinguely’s “meta-mechanics” are understood the world over as allegories of consumerism in advanced industrial society which, having exhausted itself in hectic activity, still ends in absurdity. “Heureka” was Tinguely’s first public work.
Special Remarks The machine is still fully functional.
From April to mid-October, it goes into operation every day at 11am, 3pm, and 7pm and runs for 8 minutes.
Location “Heureka” stands in a prominent location at Zürichhorn, with a wonderful view of Lake Zurich.
The park can be reached with one of the Limmat boats, on a scheduled cruise boat , or by tram.

The Creator Jean Tinguely (1925 – 1991), who was born in the Swiss canton of Fribourg, devoted himself to kinetics – that is, the motion of material bodies under the action of forces – throughout his life.
He grew up in Basel and did an apprenticeship as a decorator at the Globus department store.
After attending the Basel School of Design, he lived for several years in Paris, where he created his first kinetic artworks.
The artist, Niki de Saint Phalle , who was also very well-known at the time, was his second wife after fabric artist, Eva Aeppli.
Jean Tinguely’s first public work stands on the shore of Lake Zurich and still works perfectly today.

Tinguely’s first public work

label: “Heureka” by Jean Tinguely
sentences: Die erste «Leerlaufmaschine» von Jean Tinguely steht am Zürichsee und ist nach wie vor im Betrieb.
Das Werk: Die kinetische Grossplastik «Heureka» aus Eisenstangen, Stahlrädern, Metallpfannen – und -rohren hat Jean Tinguely 1964 für die Landesausstellung in Lausanne geschaffen.
Der Titel «Heureka», altgriechisch für «ich hab’s gefunden!», ist dabei ironisch zu verstehen, denn die Plastik ist eine Maschine ohne Zweck.
Tinguelys «Leerlaufmaschinen» sind weltweit als Allegorien auf die Konsum- und Industriegesellschaft zu verstehen, die sich in hektischer Betriebsamkeit erschöpfen und doch im Absurden enden.
«Heureka» war Tinguelys erste öffentliche Arbeit.
Besonderes: Die Maschine ist immer noch in Betrieb.
Von April bis Mitte Oktober läuft sie täglich um 11.00 Uhr, 15.00 Uhr und 19.00 Uhr jeweils 8 Minuten.
Standort: Mit herrlichem Blick auf den Zürichsee und in die Berge steht «Heureka» prominent am Zürichhorn.
Die Wiese kann mit einem der Limmatboote, einem Rundfahrtschiff oder auch mit der Tram erreicht werden.
Der Schöpfer: Der aus dem Schweizer Kanton Fribourg stammende Jean Tinguely (1925 – 1991) beschäftigte sich zeitlebens mit Kinetik, also der Bewegungsenergie.
Tinguely wuchs in Basel auf und machte eine Lehre als Dekorateur im Warenhaus Globus .
Nach dem Besuch der Kunstgewerbeschule lebte er mehrere Jahre in Paris, wo er erste kinetische Arbeiten schuf.
Die ebenfalls sehr bekannte Künstlerin Niki de Saint Phalle war seine zweite Ehefrau nach der Materialkünstlerin Eva Aeppli.
Das erste öffentliche Werk von Jean Tinguely steht am Zürichsee und ist nach wie vor in Betrieb.

label: “Heureka” by Jean Tinguely
sentences: La première « machine sans fonction » de Jean Tinguely se trouve au bord du lac de Zurich.

L’œuvre : Créée par Jean Tinguely en 1964 pour l’exposition nationale suisse, « Eurêka » est une sculpture cinétique de grande taille construite avec des barres de fer, des roues en acier ainsi que des poêles et des tuyaux en métal.
Son titre « Eurêka », qui vient du grec ancien et signifie « j’ai trouvé ! », ne manque pas d’ironie, car la sculpture est une machine inutile.

Les machines sculptures de Tinguely, qui trouvent écho partout dans le monde, sont une métaphore de la société industrielle et de consommation, s'épuisant par leur rythme frénétique et pourtant finissant dans l'absurde.
« Eurêka » fut la première œuvre publique de Tinguely.
Particularités : La machine fonctionne toujours.
Entre avril et mi-octobre, elle s’anime tous les jours à 11h, 15h et 19h pendant 8 minutes.
Emplacement : Accessible en bateau Limmatboot , bateau de croisière ou tram, « Eurêka » occupe un emplacement prestigieux au Zürichhorn avec une vue splendide sur le lac de Zurich et les montagnes.
Le créateur : L’artiste suisse Jean Tinguely (1925 – 1991) s’est penché toute sa vie sur l’énergie cinétique.
Provenant du canton de Fribourg, Tinguely a grandi à Bâle, où il a fait un apprentissage en tant que décorateur pour le grand magasin Globus .
Après ses études à l’école des arts et des métiers, il a vécu à Paris pendant plusieurs années, où il a créé ses premières œuvres cinétiques.
Il s’est marié deux fois, d’abord avec l’artiste Eva Aeppli et ensuite avec Niki de Saint Phalle , une artiste également très connue.
Située au bord du lac de Zurich, la première œuvre publique de Jean Tinguely fonctionne toujours.
Créée pour l’exposition nationale suisse de 1964

label: “Heureka” by Jean Tinguely
sentences: La prima “macchina a vuoto” di Jean Tinguely si trova in riva al Lago di Zurigo e funziona ancora oggi.
L’opera La grande scultura cinetica “Heureka”, realizzata con barre di ferro, ruote di acciaio, dischi e tubi metallici, è stata realizzata da Jean Tinguely nel 1964 per l’EXPO di Losanna.
Il titolo “Heureka”, che, in greco antico, esprime gioia per aver trovato soluzione a un problema difficile, ha valenza ironica, dato che la scultura è una macchina senza alcuno scopo.

Le “macchine a vuoto” di Tinguely vengono interpretate in tutto il mondo come allegorie della società consumistica e industriale, che si esauriscono per la loro frenetica attività, sfociando nell’assurdo. “Heureka” è stata la prima opera pubblica di Tinguely.
Particolarità La macchina è tuttora in funzione.
Da aprile a metà ottobre, viene azionata tutti i giorni alle 11.00, alle 15.00 e alle 19.00 per 8 minuti ogni volta.
Luogo Con una splendida vista sul Lago di Zurigo e sulle montagne, “Heureka” occupa una posizione di spicco sullo Zürichhorn.
Il prato può essere raggiunto con una delle barche della Limmat, un battello o il tram.
L’autore Originario del cantone svizzero di Friburgo, Jean Tinguely (1925 – 1991) si è occupato per tutta la vita di cinetica, ovvero dell’energia del movimento.
Tinguely è cresciuto a Basilea, dove ha fatto un tirocinio per diventare decoratore ai grandi magazzini Globus .
Dopo aver frequentato la scuola di arti applicate, ha vissuto svariati anni a Parigi, dove ha realizzato i suoi primi lavori cinetici.
La famosa artista Niki de Saint Phalle è stata la sua seconda moglie dopo l’artista Eva Aeppli.
La prima opera pubblica di Jean Tinguely si trova in riva al Lago di Zurigo e funziona ancora oggi.

label: Ethnographic Museum at the University of Zurich
sentences: The social anthropology science museum stands in a beautiful location in the heart of the city in the Old Botanical Garden.
The Ethnological Museum of the University of Zurich is an ethnological science museum that preserves and researches objects from all over the world.
Through research, teaching, and public outreach activities, it focuses on human skills and showcases the full range and diversity of human competences.

In exchange with members or descendants of those communities who invented, produced and used them, the objects in our collections are explored in the light of topical questions and, if possible, researched in a collaborative manner.
The provenance of the objects and the circumstances of their acquisition, as well as the colonial past of collections, are also addressed.
Moreover, (self-) critical questions are asked about who actually talks about cultures and societies and how they are represented.
As a place of dialogue, the Ethnographic Museum at the University of Zurich encourages the public to reflect on what it means to be human.
The Ethnographic Museum is located in the city center in the old botanical gardens by the Schanzengraben

In Forschung, Lehre und Vermittlung lenkt es den Blick auf die Fertigkeiten der Menschheit und zeigt menschliche Kompetenzen in der gesamten Bandbreite und Vielfalt.

Dabei werden auch die Herkunft von Objekten und die Umstände ihres Erwerbs sowie die koloniale Vergangenheit von Sammlungen thematisiert.
Es werden auch (selbst-)kritische Fragen danach gestellt, wer eigentlich wie über Kulturen und Gesellschaften spricht, wie diese also repräsentiert werden.
Als Ort des Dialogs regt das Völkerkundemuseum der Universität Zürich zum Nachdenken darüber an, was es bedeutet, Mensch zu sein.

sentences: Stained-glass windows by Sigmar Polke have adorned the Grossmünster in Zurich since 2009, impressing the many visitors.
Since 2009, artistically designed stained-glass windows by Sigmar Polke have decorated the Grossmünster church .
This well-known German artist crafted seven windows in the nave from agate.
He cut this semi-precious stone into thin slices that would let light pass through them and give the appearance of brightly glowing walls.
The brilliantly colorful result was then expanded with five figurative glass windows.
The motifs feature Old Testament figures: the scapegoat, Isaac, the Son of Man, Elijah and David.
They all move in the direction of the birth of Christ and thus toward the chancel window created by Augusto Giacometti in 1933.

The Creator Max Bill (1907 – 1994) was born in Winterthur and made a name for himself as an artist, architect, painter, graphic designer, and sculptor.

label: “L’ange protecteur” by Niki de Saint Phalle
sentences: A gigantic “Nana” in the shape of a guardian angel watches over travelers as they pass through the main concourse at Zurich Main Station.
The Work The colorful guardian angel at Zurich Main Station measures 11 meters (36ft) tall and weighs 1.2 tonnes (1.3 short tons), and is a familiar sight to Zurich commuters.
The angel was a gift from the company, Securitas, to commemorate the 150th anniversary of the Swiss Federal Railways and was shipped in three parts from the USA via Rotterdam and Basel to Zurich.
The artist, Niki de Saint Phalle, supervised the installation in person.
Special Remarks The sculpture’s colorful attire and golden wings are dusted every three months.
As Niki de Saint Phalle used watercolors, the angel can only be carefully cleaned with a duster and a compressed air spray, for otherwise the colors would fade.
Location The “L‘ange protecteur” can hardly be missed in the main concourse of Zurich Main Station, even if it does hover high above the heads of passers-by.
The Creator Initially laughed at for her colorful “Nanas”, French artist Niki de Saint Phalle (1930 – 2002) soon became famous all over the world.
Her voluptuous Nana figures represent joyful, liberated, and self-assured women.
The largest Nana was created together with Jean Tinguely , who was later to become her husband.
The gigantic “Nana” watches over travelers as they pass through the concourse at Zurich Main Station.

sentences: Dans le hall principal de la gare centrale de Zurich, une « Nana » immense en forme d’ange protecteur veille sur les voyageurs.

La sculpture offerte par Securitas à l’occasion du 150e anniversaire des Chemins de fer suisses a été divisée en trois parties pour être transportée par bateau des États-Unis à Bâle, via Rotterdam, et ensuite à Zurich.
Niki de Saint Phalle en personne supervisait l’installation de sa sculpture dans la gare centrale de Zurich.
Particularités : La robe colorée et les ailes dorées sont dépoussiérées tous les trois mois.

Comme Niki de Saint Phalle a utilisé de la peinture à l’eau, l’ange demande un entretien précautionneux et ne peut être nettoyé qu’avec un plumeau et une bombe à air comprimé, autrement les couleurs pâliraient.
Emplacement : Bien que suspendu très au-dessus des passants, l’ange protecteur dans le hall principal de la gare centrale de Zurich est un véritable accroche-regard.
La créatrice : Niki de Saint Phalle (1930 – 2002) qui, initialement, ne fut pas prise au sérieux pour ses « Nanas » colorées, connut bientôt une célébrité mondiale.
Ses « Nanas » volumineuses représentent des femmes gaies, libérées et fières.
L’artiste française a créé la plus grande de ses « Nanas » en collaboration avec son futur mari Jean Tinguely .

sentences: Un’enorme “Nana” nelle vesti di angelo custode veglia sui viaggiatori nel padiglione principale della Stazione Centrale di Zurigo.
